limitations: Host Context/preferences/system adapters are not Android APIs.
Negative probes use loopback HTTP; sync safety suite uses a synthetic transport.
The local server suite uses a serial in-memory pg adapter. Real PostgreSQL/Android results are recorded separately.
No real user data or production API writes.
Conflicting edits/new numeric-ID collisions are retained and refused, not silently resolved.
No Render deployment, iOS work, store upload or signing change.
